description:
kith-chat/src/permission.rs::resolve_permission() calls four store methods in sequence: is_member(), get_member_role_ids(), load_roles(), and load_channel_permission_overrides(). Each is a separate SQL round-trip to SQLite.

This function is called on every channel message send and every channel read, making it a per-request overhead multiplier for Spaces users.

The four queries can be collapsed into two (or one CTE): 1) a single query joining space_members, space_member_roles, and space_roles to fetch membership status, role IDs, and role permissions in one pass; 2) the existing load_channel_permission_overrides query for the channel.

For Phase 1 single-user deployments without Spaces this is zero-overhead. For Spaces with many concurrent channels or high-frequency clients, this is O(4) queries per operation where O(2) suffices.
title: resolve_permission makes 4 separate DB queries per permission check
